command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== step: baseline =="
hostname; echo "NODE_IP=$NODE_IP"
sudo -n systemctl is-active sshd
ls -la /etc/ssh/ | grep -E 'host_key|cert' || true

echo "== step: create CA =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/ssh/ca
if [ ! -f /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca ]; then
  sudo -n ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca -N '' -C "ssh-ca@$(hostname)"
fi
sudo -n chmod 600 /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca.pub

echo "== step: determine host public key =="
HOSTKEY=/etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key
if [ ! -f "${HOSTKEY}.pub" ]; then
  HOSTKEY=$(ls /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key.pub | head -1 | sed 's/\.pub$//')
fi
echo "Using host key: $HOSTKEY"

echo "== step: sign host key to produce certificate =="
sudo -n ssh-keygen -s /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca -I "$(hostname)-host" -h -n "$(hostname),$NODE_IP,localhost" -V +3650d "${HOSTKEY}.pub"
sudo -n chmod 644 "${HOSTKEY}-cert.pub"
ls -la "${HOSTKEY}-cert.pub"

echo "== step: configure sshd to present certificate =="
CERTLINE="HostCertificate ${HOSTKEY}-cert.pub"
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
if ! sudo -n grep -q "HostCertificate" /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-ssh-ca-cert.conf 2>/dev/null; then
  printf '%s\n' "$CERTLINE" | sudo -n tee /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-ssh-ca-cert.conf
fi
sudo -n sshd -t
sudo -n systemctl restart sshd
sudo -n systemctl is-active sshd

echo "== step: verify certificate is presented =="
ssh-keyscan -t ssh-ed25519-cert-v01@openssh.com "$NODE_IP" 2>/dev/null || true
ssh-keyscan "$NODE_IP" 2>/dev/null | grep cert || true

echo "== step: inspect certificate content =="
sudo -n ssh-keygen -L -f "${HOSTKEY}-cert.pub"

echo "== step: simulate client trust and connect without host key pinning =="
sudo -n cat /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca.pub | sed 's/^/@cert-authority \*,'"$NODE_IP"',localhost,'"$(hostname)"' /' > /tmp/known_hosts_ca
cat /tmp/known_hosts_ca
ssh -o UserKnownHostsFile=/tmp/known_hosts_ca -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=[REDACTED] -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 "$NODE_IP" 'echo CONNECTED_VIA_CA_TRUST' 2>&1 || true
echo "== DONE =="
